categories.label: Plan a trip
categories.description: Round-trip flight and hotel concierge planning via the interactive AI chat assistant.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Mumbai to Lucknow for 2 adults from 16 to 19 November 2026 under ₹45000.
examples.label: Mumbai → Lucknow · 2 adults
examples.expected_behavior: Extracts origin Mumbai, destination Lucknow, dates 16-19 Nov 2026, 2 travellers, budget ₹45000; returns 3 complete round-trip packages within budget.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹45,000 cap (lowest total: ₹35,975.79).
examples.notes: Real scheduled flights and verified hotel rooms.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Ahmedabad to Bengaluru for 2 adults from 14 October 2026 to 19 October 2026 under ₹100000.
examples.label: Ahmedabad → Bengaluru
examples.expected_behavior: Extracts Ahmedabad to Bengaluru for 5 nights with ₹100000 cap; returns 3 package options.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹100,000 cap (selected cart total: ₹88,173.25).
examples.notes: Covers multi-night stay with flight pairing.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Ahmedabad to Hyderabad for 2 adults from 15 to 18 October 2026 under ₹55000.
examples.label: Ahmedabad → Hyderabad
examples.expected_behavior: Extracts Ahmedabad to Hyderabad with ₹55000 cap; finds available flights and stays within budget.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹55,000 cap (selected cart total: ₹31,541.48).
examples.notes: Comfortably fits within budget.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Ahmedabad to Lucknow for 2 adults from 7 to 12 November 2026 under ₹80000.
examples.label: Ahmedabad → Lucknow · 5 nights
examples.expected_behavior: Plans a 5-night trip from 7 to 12 Nov 2026 within ₹80000 cap; returns 3 packages.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹80,000 cap (selected cart total: ₹49,794.78).
examples.notes: 5-night hotel occupancy checked night by night.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Bengaluru to Jaipur for 2 adults from 4 to 9 November 2026 under ₹75000.
examples.label: Bengaluru → Jaipur
examples.expected_behavior: Plans round trip between Bengaluru and Jaipur within ₹75000 cap.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹75,000 cap (selected cart total: ₹51,860.51).
examples.notes: Cultural destination route with hotel verification.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Chennai to Pune for 2 adults from 3 Nov to 7 Nov 2026 under ₹65000.
examples.label: Chennai → Pune
examples.expected_behavior: Parses abbreviated month names '3 Nov to 7 Nov'; plans trip within ₹65000 cap.
examples.observed_result: 1 package option returned within ₹65,000 cap (cart total: ₹31,029.03).
examples.notes: Tests abbreviated month parsing.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Ahmedabad to New Delhi for 2 adults from 3 to 5 November 2026 under ₹45000.
examples.label: Ahmedabad → New Delhi
examples.expected_behavior: Plans a quick 2-night trip to New Delhi within ₹45000 cap.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹45,000 cap (selected cart total: ₹33,030.51).
examples.notes: Alias 'New Delhi' matched and verified.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Ahmedabad to Lucknow for 2 adults from 10 to 12 November 2026 under ₹35000.
examples.label: Lucknow · 2 nights
examples.expected_behavior: Plans a budget-tight 2-night trip to Lucknow under ₹35000.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹35,000 cap (selected cart total: ₹28,346.52).
examples.notes: Strict budget enforcement.

examples.prompt: Plan a trip from Mumbai to Kolkata for 5 adults from 12 to 16 October 2026 under ₹50000.
examples.label: Mumbai → Kolkata · 5 adults
examples.expected_behavior: Parses party size of 5; finds outbound flight on 12 Oct; detects return flight on 16 Oct has insufficient capacity for 5 adults; triggers clarification offering later available return dates without altering original dates.
examples.observed_result: Outbound seats confirmed (BA-6548). No 5-seat return available on 16 Oct. Clarification requested with interactive date chips for 4 Nov and 19 Nov.
examples.notes: Canonical regression test case. Never invents availability or silently alters dates.

examples.prompt: Plan a 3-night trip from Mumbai to Lucknow on 16 November 2026 for 3 adults under ₹90000.
examples.label: Mumbai → Lucknow · 3 adults
examples.expected_behavior: Parses duration phrasing ('3-night') and adds 3 days to start date 16 Nov 2026 (check-out 19 Nov 2026) for 3 adults under ₹90000 cap.
examples.observed_result: 3 package options returned within ₹90,000 cap (selected cart total: ₹79,379.93).
examples.notes: Tests duration offset logic for odd traveller counts.

categories.label: Find flights
categories.description: Direct one-way flight search with route, date, passengers, and cabin class.

examples.prompt: Find flights from Mumbai to Lucknow on 16 November 2026 for 2 passengers.
examples.expected_behavior: Direct flight search returns available scheduled fares for 2 passengers in economy.
examples.observed_result: 1 fare returned with real inventory.
examples.notes: Direct Flights search does not support budget filtering.

examples.prompt: Find flights from Lucknow to Mumbai on 19 November 2026 for 2 passengers.
examples.expected_behavior: Returns return leg options from Lucknow to Mumbai on 19 Nov 2026.
examples.observed_result: 2 fares returned.
examples.notes: Demonstrates return flight inventory.

examples.prompt: Find flights from Ahmedabad to Bengaluru on 14 October 2026 for 2 passengers.
examples.expected_behavior: Searches and returns direct flights for 2 passengers on 14 Oct 2026.
examples.observed_result: 2 fares returned.
examples.notes: Database validated schedule.

examples.prompt: Find flights from Mumbai to Kolkata on 12 October 2026 for 5 passengers.
examples.expected_behavior: Searches outbound flight for 5 passengers; verifies sufficient inventory (5+ seats).
examples.observed_result: 2 fares returned with seats for five.
examples.notes: Validates group availability on outbound leg.

examples.prompt: Find flights from Kolkata to Mumbai on 16 October 2026 for 5 passengers.
examples.expected_behavior: Detects zero fares for 5 passengers on 16 Oct 2026; returns empty result with nearby available dates.
examples.observed_result: No fare for 5 passengers on 16 Oct; suggested available dates 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-19.
examples.notes: Maintains data fidelity without fabricating flights.

categories.label: Find hotels
categories.description: Direct hotel search with destination, check-in, check-out, guests, and whole-stay budget.

examples.prompt: Find hotels in Lucknow from 16 to 19 November 2026 for 2 adults under ₹40000 total.
examples.expected_behavior: Searches Lucknow hotels for 3 nights within ₹40000 total stay budget.
examples.observed_result: 8 room/stay options returned.
examples.notes: Budget applies to whole stay, not per night.

examples.prompt: Find hotels in Bengaluru from 14 to 19 October 2026 for 2 adults under ₹100000 total.
examples.expected_behavior: Searches Bengaluru hotels for 5 nights within ₹100000 total stay budget.
examples.observed_result: 1 room/stay option returned.
examples.notes: Nightly rate multiplied across 5 nights.

examples.prompt: Find hotels in Hyderabad from 15 to 18 October 2026 for 2 adults under ₹55000 total.
examples.expected_behavior: Searches Hyderabad hotels for 3 nights within ₹55000 total stay budget.
examples.observed_result: 1 room/stay option returned.
examples.notes: Enforces room occupancy capacity.

examples.prompt: Find hotels in Jaipur from 4 to 9 November 2026 for 2 adults under ₹75000 total.
examples.expected_behavior: Searches Jaipur hotels for 5 nights within ₹75000 total stay budget.
examples.observed_result: 5 room/stay options returned.
examples.notes: Returns multiple hotel options.

examples.prompt: Find hotels in Kolkata from 12 to 16 October 2026 for 5 adults under ₹100000 total.
examples.expected_behavior: Checks Kolkata inventory for 5 adults; finds no single room type or units meeting occupancy; returns zero results cleanly without hallucination.
examples.observed_result: Zero rooms returned for 5 adults over full stay.
examples.notes: Preserves inventory integrity.
